d:
An attempt at a rescue job. I'm still an MTL man, but I can certainly do better than just dumping a volume into an LLM, then uploading the raw output without any editing.

Please make fun of me. It took until I was actually mid typesetting in the last page to notice the pile of corpses and burned out rubble. Which revised a lot of my opinions on how wholesome this one was.

I found Baphy to be a deeply unsettling creature, and I really hope I got that across.

There was some significant debate about how to spell Baphy's name. If you go by the japanese, it's either "Bapho" or "Bafo", but neither of those sound quite right in english. At the very least, I've never heard a native english speaker trim a word to leave a hanging "O" like that. Ultimately, one of my proofers suggested "Baphy" as a close enough equivalent, and I ran with it.

I hope you all enjoyed.

You can find the original here:

https://e-hentai.org/g/2788220/1224f6520c/
